Apacer AH180 64GB USB 3.2 Type-C Dual Flash Drive – Red

The Apacer AH180 64GB USB Flash Drive is a compact and high-speed storage solution designed with a dual interface – USB Type-C and USB Type-A – making it perfect for data transfer between smartphones, tablets, laptops, and desktops. With USB 3.2 Gen 1 performance, it delivers fast and reliable read/write speeds for everyday file storage and backup.


Key Features:

  • 64GB Storage Capacity – Ideal for documents, photos, videos, and more
  • Dual USB Connectors – Type-C for mobile devices, Type-A for PCs/laptops
  • USB 3.2 Gen 1 – High-speed data transfer with backward compatibility
  • Compact & Durable – Lightweight with stylish metallic red finish
  • Plug & Play – No drivers needed; works instantly on compatible devices
  • Compatibility: Windows, macOS, Linux
  • Android smartphones and tablets with OTG support

Specifications:

  • Capacity: 64GB
  • Interface: USB 3.2 Gen 1 Type-C & Type-A
  • Color: Red
  • Dimensions: 32.8 x 12.1 x 8.1 mm
  • Weight: 3.6g
